```xml
<screen id="wizard" label="Setup wizard" weft="0.1">
  <heading id="title" level="1">Choose a plan</heading>
  <text id="progress" text="{$.progress}"/>
  <radio-group id="plan" label="Plan" value="{$.plan}">
    <radio id="plan-free" value="free">Free</radio>
    <radio id="plan-pro" value="pro">Pro</radio>
    <radio id="plan-team" value="team">Team</radio>
    <radio id="plan-enterprise" value="enterprise">Enterprise</radio>
  </radio-group>
  <stack id="nav" direction="row" gap="{token.space.sm}">
    <button id="back" on-press="wizard.back">Back</button>
    <button id="next" disabled="{!$.plan}" variant="primary" on-press="wizard.next">Next</button>
  </stack>
</screen>
```
